Chapter 733 - 733 Annihilation In One Move; Anger!

Chapter 733 - 733 Annihilation in One Move; Anger!

733 Annihilation in One Move; Anger!

Ten years passed in the blink of an eye.

Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao returned to the dark universe continent that was filled with a stench.

Compared to ten years ago, their appearances now had a few more hints of evilness.

They had a few obviously strange talismans on their bodies, a scarlet vertical pupil between their eyebrows, and a string of small skull-like pendants hanging around their necks.

They charged forward and easily tore the monsters not far away into pieces.

From the aura they gave off, they were actually domain lord level 9!

In fact, he was only a step away from breaking through to the universe level!

Such a breakthrough speed was simply shocking.

“Cheng Zhen, how is it?” Li Hao asked excitedly. Didn’t I say that you can quickly become stronger after entering the mystic realm?”

Lin Chengzhen smiled and shook his head.

He still vaguely remembered Li Hao apologizing to him ten years ago.

However, just as Li Hao said, he had become stronger!

He had become very strong!

“Let’s go and take revenge!” Li Hao said.”

“Good!” Lin Chengzhen said.

Before long, they encountered three monsters.

Ten years ago, Lin Chengzhen and Li Hao could only run away when they met him.

But now, he was beaten until he kept coughing up blood.

“How did you suddenly become so powerful?” the three-headed monster asked in shock.”

What responded to him was Li Hao’s saber that was dozens of meters long.

Blood splattered everywhere.

….

On the other hand, Earth.

In these 10 years, Lin Fan was the same as the past few years. Whenever he was free, he would work hard.

He worked very hard.

Unfortunately, the result was not satisfactory.

Other than Huang Ling, there were still no signs of life in the stomachs of the others.

After 10 years of careful recuperation.

Other than obvious signs of life, Huang Ling’s stomach did not bulge at all.

Huang Ling was already mentally prepared for this, so she wasn’t too worried.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had obtained five Transcendence Golden Bodies, four Immortal Crystals, two Emperor Grade equipment, and some treasures to cultivate the power of laws from the system.

Lin Fan’s cultivation state had risen once again, reaching King level 8.

….

On this day, Lin Fan had just finished working hard.

He suddenly raised his eyebrows.

That was because a crisp notification sounded out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Level 1 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 2 King Stage cultivator detected.]

[Ding! Level 3 King Stage cultivator detected.]

….

Lin Fan raised his head slowly and looked out into the endless void.

A huge golden battleship appeared in the sky above Earth.

There was a huge Z at the bottom of the warship.

Inside the battleship, there were a man with a seal head, a man with a whale head, a man with a sea snake head, and a powerful aura around him.

They were a group of experts sent by the center of the ocean universe to deal with the hidden enemies of the Four Seasons Universe.

If an ordinary person saw them, they would definitely be scared out of their wits.

However, Lin Fan’s face remained calm.

That was because, under the observation of the Heavenly Eye, all the people on the warship were covered in weaknesses, and they could be destroyed with a flip of their hands.

He took a step forward and disappeared from the Coiling Dragon Villa.

….

At this moment, in the golden warship.

Men with powerful auras stared at the blue planet in front of them with sharp eyes.

“5901, 234, 199, this is it.”

“Isn’t it just an ordinary planet?”

“Hmm? Something didn’t seem right. Why did this planet have such dense spiritual energy?”

“What astonishing spiritual energy!”

“Not only spiritual energy, but many spiritual dragons have also appeared!”

“There is definitely a big secret on this planet!”

As they spoke, their gazes towards Earth gradually became incomparably greedy.

“Break the protective shield first!”

A thick energy ray that was like a pillar that reached the sky poured down.

“Whoosh!”

Almost at the same time as the energy beam fell, a light sword ten times the size of the energy beam came straight at him.

The entire universe was covered in white light.

In the golden battleship, the eyes of the man with the seal head, the man with the whale head, the man with the sea snake head, and everyone else narrowed as they shouted in fear,””Not good!”

Their hair instantly stood on end. They wanted to dodge, but it was already too late.

“Boom!”

An earth-shattering explosion sounded.

The golden battleship exploded in an instant. It was dazzling and resplendent.

Annihilate the enemy in one move!

Lin Fan used his golden eyes to scan for two seconds. After confirming that he had killed all the enemies, he turned around and returned to Earth.

Lin Fan would never show any mercy to those who wanted to harm Earth.

….

At the center of the ocean universe.

One after another, mail after mail came from all the universes.

Countless murlocs quickly gathered and analyzed the information and issued orders.

Everything was handled in an orderly manner.

“Beep beep beep!”

At this moment, an urgent alarm suddenly sounded at the scene.

All the mermen looked over.

The next moment, all the mermen widened their eyes in unison.

“We lost contact with the Z010 gold warship?!”

“Quickly try calling!”

….

“Beep toot!”

However, no matter how much they called, all they got was a busy tone.

“What is the mission of the Z010 gold warship?”

“Dealing with the powerful enemies in the Four Seasons Universe’s Spring Region, coordinates 6521, 111, 134; 2131,322,141.. 5901,234,199.Not long ago, the Z010 golden warship sent back news that it had successfully solved the problem of coordinates 5210, 132, 099. The location where the Z010 golden warship lost its signal was 5901, 234, 199!”

“Quick, report the situation!”

“Yes, sir!”

This news kept being uploaded.

Before long, it appeared in the hands of Ocean Universe Master.

Ocean Universe Master was a nine-headed flood dragon, and his body was filled with endless terrifying power. With just a glance, he could tear any living being into pieces.

“The destruction of the Z010 gold warship is a provocation to the ocean universe!”

His voice was like thunder, causing the entire palace to tremble.

It had to be said that this nine-headed flood dragon was truly domineering.

He let people invade other people’s territory.

When others resisted, he said that they were provoking him.

After a while, the nine-headed flood dragon spoke again,””Zach, I appoint you as the commander-in-chief of the crusade. You will lead the Z001, Z002, Z003, Z004, Z005, Z006, Z007, Z008, and Z009 battleships to completely destroy the Spring Field coordinates 5901, 234, and 199 planets.”

“I want you to make a name for yourself in the ocean universe!”

When everyone in the hall heard this, they could not help but be shocked.

One had to know that Zach had already reached the ninth layer of the king level hundreds of thousands of years ago.

Some people said that he had already broken through to the Imperial level.

Some even said that he had already defeated an Emperor-ranked powerhouse!

However, no matter what, his strength was publicly acknowledged.

With him as the commander, he would lead nine Gold Z-series warships.

This was enough to show how much importance and rage Ocean Universe Master placed on coordinates 5901, 234, 199!

Below, a man with a flood dragon head said respectfully,””Yes, sir!”

With a flash, he disappeared from the hall.

The entire palace regained its peace.
